Welcome to Vicar's Green Primary School
It gives me great pleasure to welcome you to Vicar’s Green Primary School’s website. Our website will give you an idea of our ethos and culture, and will hopefully give you a flavour of life at our wonderfully diverse and well established school. All our stake holders believe that all children have the potential to achieve their goals and succeed in every aspect of life.
It is the aim of the whole school team to help each child become a successful learner and a well-rounded individual, who is ready to take the next steps in their learning journey.

pageCache.pageTitle: Vicar's Green Primary School - British Values
pageCache.text:
British Values
In accordance with The Department for Education
we aim to actively promote British values in schools to
ensure young people leave school prepared for life in modern Britain.
Pupils are encouraged to regard people of all faiths, races and cultures
with respect and tolerance and understand that while different people may hold different views about what is ‘right’ and ‘wrong’, all people living in England are subject to its law.
We celebrate and learn about a different value each month.
Our values are displayed on the Vicar's Green Values Tree on a display board in the school.
Freedom, Respect, Responsibility, Team Work, Empathy, Perseverance, Equality, Tolerance, Honesty, Compassion, Courage and Peace.
tolerance of those of different faiths and beliefs

pageCache.text:
Our Vision
Vision for Vicar’s Green Primary School
Vicar’s Green Primary School is a highly successful and happy school with a caring ethos. Our teaching staff, non-teaching staff and governors are dedicated professionals, who are fully committed to ensuring that every child reaches their full potential.
Here, every child’s contribution and achievements are valued and acknowledged.
We have high expectations of learning and behaviour and strive to reach standards that make us really proud. Together, we work proactively to improve the provision for all our pupils. Our aim is to make a difference and to improve the life chances of the children.
Maintain our standard of academic excellence

pageCache.text:
Welcome
It gives me great pleasure to welcome you to Vicar’s Green Primary School’s website. Our website will give you an idea of our ethos and culture, and will hopefully give you a flavour of life at our wonderfully diverse and well established school. All our stake holders believe that all children have the potential to achieve their goals and succeed in every aspect of life.
It is the aim of the whole school team to help each child become a successful learner and a well-rounded individual, who is ready to take the next steps in their learning journey. We are not only committed to supporting every child reach their full academic potential, but we also strongly believe in nurturing within our pupils a love for music, arts and sports.
If you are a prospective parent and would like further information about the school, or to attend a guided tour, please contact the school office. Guided tours are held on the last Thursday of each month.

pageCache.pageTitle: Vicar's Green Primary School - Curriculum Intent
pageCache.text:
Curriculum Intent
Knowledge lessons prioritise memory, instruction and practice;
Skills lessons prioritise engagement, collaboration and reflection.
All aspects of our curriculum are accessible to all children, irrespective of their ethnic background, gender, disability, religious or linguistic background. We strive hard to meet the needs of those pupils with special educational needs, those with disabilities, those who are more able, those with special gifts and talents and the children who are learning English as an additional language. We provide a rich, challenging curriculum, which stretches all of our children. Staff are aware of children who have exceptional talents and gifts and monitor or track their progress carefully to ensure their academic potential or talent is continually developed. For further details see separate policies: Inclusion, More Able, Gifted and Talented.
